answer: A farm can print a thousand names in a minute, but it cannot print a past. Satellite ground-station licence with spectrum regulator attestation is the past that counts: a spectrum licence number verifiable in the regulator's public register. The grove of the defence is the calendar - every entry was written when it was written, before witnesses the applicant does not control. The oasis in the middle is the price: years of fees and face-to-face checks. The inlet that ends it is the audit, which takes seconds.
